name: Fervor & Zeal
author: Jay Buys

sections.description:
Fervor & Zeal is a new kind of apparel company that donates 50% of the profits from every product sold, 25% to the artist who designed it and 25% to an affilliated nonprofit.

Our plugin allows you to easily embed Fervor & Zeal products into your WordPress website, along with functionality to check out and process payments.

External services

This plugin uses the Shopify Buy Button API to connect to the Fervor & Zeal store and display the products and to do so will, it will load JavaScript from https://sdks.shopifycdn.com/.
This service is provided by Shopify. The terms of use can be found at https://www.shopify.com/legal.
sections.installation:
Upload the Fervor & Zeal pluging to your website (or install it from the WordPress Plugin Directory) and activate it.

Within WordPress, navigate to Settings > Fervor & Zeal to select your products and create shortcodes.

Embed the shortcodes into your posts or pages to display the products, along with buttons to purchase.

It’s that simple!

screenshots.caption: Install the plugin and navigate to Settings > Fervor & Zeal. Select an organization from the dropdown.
Select the product you wish to embed on your site and click "Select Product".
Choose some styling options and click "Choose Styling Options".
Copy the shortcode and paste it into your post or page.

Previously generated shortcodes are displayed below the form. You can delete them by clicking the "Delete" button next to the shortcode. (Also remember to remove the shortcode from your pages or posts.)
